dialog.title: Tanga igikorwa cyo gukurikirana cya porogaramu
dialog.description: Igikorwa kitari icy'ubuvuzi gihabwa umuyobozi w'ikigo {{facility}}. Ntigihindura inyandiko y'ubuvuzi.
dialog.notSavedHint: Ihuza ryanze. Kongera kugerageza nta kibazo: ntibishobora gukora ikindi gisa na cyo.

field.title: Umutwe
field.titleHint: Inyuguti 5 kugeza 120. Ntukandike amazina cyangwa imyirondoro y'abarwayi.
field.noteHint: Si ngombwa, inyuguti zitarenze 500. Ibisobanuro rusange gusa — nta makuru y'umurwayi.

card.title: Ibikorwa bya porogaramu
card.note: Ibikorwa byo gukurikirana bitari iby'ubuvuzi bihabwa abayobozi b'ibigo muri uru rwego.
card.emptyHint: Tanga kimwe uhereye ku murongo w'ikigo mu isesengura ry'icyiciro.
